name: ado-grok
description: Connect Grok Bot to Azure DevOps via Microsoft's official local MCP (@azure-devops/mcp). PAT auth on the bot computer — no user laptop or Azure CLI required. Work items, repos/PRs, and pipelines for org SimplAutomation (configurable).

ADO_ORG.title: Azure DevOps organization
ADO_ORG.description: Organization name only (e.g. SimplAutomation), not the full URL.

ADO_PAT.title: Azure DevOps PAT (base64)
ADO_PAT.description: Base64 of email:PAT (email can be any non-empty string). Example: printf '%s' 'you@example.com:YOUR_PAT' | base64. Scopes: Work Items, Code, Build (and others you need). Never paste the raw PAT without encoding.
